exportDescription: Daily counts, event times, duration and your custom categories
countDescription: Daily count for this recorded habit. Missing is unknown; an explicit zero means none.
durationDescription: Total recorded minutes for this habit. Missing duration is not zero.
timeDescription: Mean sine/cosine of local event times; available only when every counted event has a time. Select both components. Not elapsed hours.
nameError: Custom activities need a name; preset names come from the catalog.
timeCountError: Recorded times cannot exceed the daily count.
zeroDurationError: A zero count cannot have a positive duration.
duplicateError: Record each habit only once per day; combine its events in that row.
legacyError: This entry contains newer activity fields. Reload the app before saving.
